hypothesis: A new native-tokenless four-state/four-action causal effect model can transfer learned state-invariant action effects across unfamiliar action-state combinations and retain earlier causes, improving over fully trained per-cell tabular while remaining near exact Bayesian structural posterior.
native_representation: Experimental research-only new state and action IDs 0..3. Learn 4x4 authentic action-to-XOR-delta counts Dirichlet(0.25) and four terminal reward Beta(1,1) cells. Each observed s0,a1,s1,a2,s2,y adds TWO real observed action effects plus ONE reward. Do not alter accepted binary NativeEpisodeExperience or PublicCausalCells.
experiment: Two hidden-action-permutation worlds: action identity -> unique 2-bit XOR delta via a random hidden bijection (24 possibilities). W0 terminal Bernoulli reward true-bit parity of two state bits, W1 true-bit OR. Transition noise intended next state .9 and each other next state .1/3; terminal reward true-bit .9, false-bit .1. No hidden mapping/reward passed to trained models. Actual public source episodes are the only training data.
data_schedule: Per world 96 source episodes using old actions 0,1; 96 using new primitive actions 2,3; 48 old action return. 240 episodes/world; 2 worlds/seed; two genuine transitions plus final public reward. Exactly identical source events/context/actions/outcomes across arms; no future/counterfactual oracle observations given to learners.
candidate: Native four-way effect distribution transports action delta across all four states. Two-stage reward forecast is compositional sum over both learned stochastic actions and learned reward-state Beta. Unique source IDs, canonical exact cold checkpoint, no replay, no alias to binary.
strong_controls: Exact posterior over all 24 hidden action->delta permutations with uniform prior and known .9/.1/3 transition noise, source-trained on both actual witnessed transitions, plus identically source-trained Beta reward-state posterior. Exact control evaluates both action effects jointly using one posterior hypothesis, NOT independent marginals. Second control fully trained unstructured Dirichlet(.25) per observed (state,action) 4-way next-state + same reward Beta. Weak uniform .5 reward and .25 next-state sham. True mapping is evaluator-only, never a fitted control or a performance ceiling.
probe: At t=96,112,128,144,160,176,192,208,224 *before* source event, an evaluator checks all 64 s0,a1,a2 combinations. The hidden world computes exact two-transition terminal reward probability, each arm emits prequential composed reward prediction. Expected Brier (p-q)^2+q(1-q), never used as training. Group novel_early t=96,112; novel_late t=144,160,176; cold_return t=192,208,224; pooled_late_return last six.

frozen_go.decision: Any failure DEV_NO_GO. All pass DEV_FEASIBLE_NOT_SCIENTIFIC only. No postscore DEV tuning/replay or automatic held pilot/primary.

negative_controls: Source-only fixture with explicit non-XOR state-dependent action transition should show native invariant model is not automatically valid; verify end-to-end read purity, duplicates/conflict, full four-state/four-action operation, exact cold restoration. Fixture not scientific first-use.
execution: Commit prereg before code and scientific seed first-use. Fixture tests before one two-OS DEV screen at exact SHA. Preserve reports and failed thresholds in repo. Measure CPU/wall, native source count, checkpoint bytes, no claimed matched compute.
authority: Research-only branch, no accepted native source/controller/Forge runtime/main edits; no merge, scheduler, paid API, owner first-use, deployment or full final regression without scientific and acceptance authority. Full final regression not implied by DEV.
